# PREFIX-707-R6 — Partition-certified corner rectangles for the frozen BRC variance objective

Date: 2026-11-11 (Asia/Shanghai).
Frozen scientific input: awdawmip/enterprise-math@f42f2906d77f24085c123f3ccfe9667d41caa96d.
Parent goal: PREFIX-675, global optimization of the frozen two-stream stopped-clock auxiliary observer on D=[0,1/2]^2.
Direct mathematical dependencies: PREFIX-700 integer survivor recurrence; PREFIX-705 exact monotonicity of each survivor tail; PREFIX-706 Efron–Stein tensor bound and fixed competitor.
Status: AUTHOR_RECOMPUTED / EXACT_FRACTION_IMPLICATION_CHECKED / UNREVIEWED / NOT_ADMITTED.
Provenance: R6 independent mathematical continuation; the established session associated with RA-0AA45C8056A76CE3060E2C23 is a historical source, not a new task CLAIM.

## Abstract

A 256-cell interval enclosure using BOTH the increasing survivor moments and the decreasing complementary moments produces certified single-clock variance bounds much sharper than the one-interval bounds of PREFIX-706. The union of four unequal corner rectangles, C=([0,1/18] union [1/3,1/2])^2, is dominated by a fixed witness for every real sampling parameter q>=2. Its area 4/81 is 16/81 of the complete auxiliary square, 16384/3969 times the area certified in PREFIX-706.

## Frozen observer and lemma

Retain all original labelled first-stop path multiplicities. Let N_p in {25,...,189} be the informative-count stopping variable; given N_p=k, T_p follows Gamma(k,1). Let s_n(p)=Pr(N_p>n) for 0<=n<=188. For independent streams, Y(p,z)=max(T_p,T_z), mu(p,z)=E[Y], W(p,z)=Var(Y), V_q=q^2 W-q mu, q>=2.

By the 17,766 certified nonnegative Bernstein derivative coefficients of PREFIX-705, all s_n(p) are nondecreasing for 0<=p<=1/2. Define
A(p)=E[N_p]=sum s_n(p),
C(p)=E[N_p^2]=sum (2n+1)s_n(p),
d(p)=E[189-N_p]=189-A(p),
D2(p)=E[(189-N_p)^2]=189^2-378A(p)+C(p).
Then A,C are nondecreasing and d,D2 are nonincreasing. Since 25<=A<=189 and d>=0, the functions h(x)=x-x^2 and k(x)=-x-x^2 are decreasing on the relevant ranges.

**Lemma 707.1 (two-sided monotone-moment cell enclosure).** For every cell 0<=l<=p<=r<=1/2,

Var(T_p)=C(p)+A(p)-A(p)^2
       =189+D2(p)-d(p)-d(p)^2
       <= U[l,r] := min{C(r)+A(l)-A(l)^2,
                        189+D2(l)-d(r)-d(r)^2}.

**Proof.** C(p)<=C(r), A(p)>=A(l), and h is decreasing for A>=25; hence the first upper bound. Similarly D2(p)<=D2(l), d(p)>=d(r), and k is decreasing on d>=0; hence the second bound. Both upper bounds apply simultaneously, so their minimum does. All endpoint moments are exact rationals derived from the frozen 189-row integer recurrence. QED.

**Lemma 707.2 (independent-stream tensor variance bound).** For independent clocks T_p,T_z, Var(max(T_p,T_z))<=Var(T_p)+Var(T_z). This follows from the Efron–Stein inequality and the fact that max is 1-Lipschitz in either scalar input; each resampling term is bounded by the resampled clock variance. QED.

## Theorem 707.3 — 19.753% of the complete auxiliary square excluded

Take L=[0,1/18] and H=[1/3,1/2], partition each interval into 256 equal closed rational cells, and let C=(L union H)^2, the union of four product rectangles. The exact checker independently reconstructs the frozen 9,529 nonzero survivor-count cells, computes the 512 rational cell enclosures U[l,r], and obtains

max_cell_in_L U[l,r] in (263733972/10^6,263733973/10^6),
max_cell_in_H U[l,r] in (273906511/10^6,273906512/10^6).

The lower endpoint in each displayed bracket can be inclusive; the upper endpoint is STRICT. From PREFIX-706, the exact witness e=(0,3/20) satisfies B=W(e)-mu(e)/2>559812917/10^6. Consequently, for every (p,z) in C and every real q>=2,

W(p,z) < 2*273906512/10^6,
V_q(e)-V_q(p,z) > (559812917-2*273906512)/10^6*q^2
                  = 11999893/10^6*q^2
                  > 119/10*q^2 > 0.

The comparison uses mu(p,z)>=0 and W(e)-mu(e)/q>=B for q>=2. Therefore NO global maximum of V_q on the complete square lies in C. The four closed rectangles are disjoint because 1/18+1/6=2/9<1/2, and

Area(C)=(1/18+1/6)^2=4/81,
Area(C)/Area([0,1/2]^2)=16/81=19.7530864...%,
Area(C)/Area(PREFIX-706 C)=16384/3969=4.1279919... .

This statement holds for ALL real q>=2, including both endpoints of the spatial rectangles, not merely for a discrete collection of q values.

## Exact verification and reuse boundaries

Companion program PREFIX707_R6_PARTITION_CORNER_CERTIFICATE.py uses Python standard-library integer arithmetic and Fraction, reimplements the frozen 189-level survivor recurrence from PREFIX-700, checks the 9,529-cell count, reproduces PREFIX-706's L(1/64) and U(3/32) sixth-decimal enclosures, and checks all 512 two-sided cell caps. All theorem-deciding comparisons are exact fractions.

Local author execution on the supplied source: ALL_CHECKS_PASS PREFIX707-R6. The 17,766 Bernstein sign coefficients of PREFIX-705 and the exact B comparator of PREFIX-706 were used as previously published dependencies, rather than reexecuted. The theorem is about the declared auxiliary statistical observer; native X6 evolution and the full optimizer position remain their separate questions. This result is not a formal research Result/Review or independently admitted theorem.

## Remaining problem and next unit

For fixed q range 12<=q<=24, divide the remaining interior square into rational cells. Since f_t(e)-f_t(p,z) is affine in t=1/q, certify domination at t=1/24 and t=1/12 on each cell by exact Bernstein bounds; the common positive cells are excluded for the entire continuous parameter interval. Explore improved local witnesses where e does not dominate. Preserve full labelled path provenance and the frozen input pin.
